current_remote_gate_state.interpretation: The absent admission prevents this exact invocation now; the existing R047 lock is not consumed by the runner and would be bypassable after any file is placed at ROOT_ADMISSION.json.

issues.impact: Any file named ROOT_ADMISSION.json enables a GPU attempt; no root identity/hash/RID/candidate binding or R047 foreign-lock refusal exists.
issues.fix: Bind immutable root admission and atomically take/verify shared GPU lock before any service action; fail closed on R047 lock.

issues.impact: Startup imports t17_d14_* but copies differently named files and overwrites PYTHONPATH without the development root; real service cannot import the instrumentation.
issues.fix: Align copied filenames/imports and test the actual arm import path in CPU regression.

issues.impact: Endpoint lacks sampled_token_ids while comparison requires them, so real run fails; runner also ignores endpoint/input receipt SHA. FILEdry fabricates the missing tokens.
issues.fix: Bind endpoint UID to frozen input receipt and observations token events; compare actual sampled IDs/text and reject missing/error/incomplete records.

issues.impact: No PID birth, health/request, cleanup, group-dead, port-free, lock-owner, or failed terminal receipt is persisted; exception paths cannot prove safe stop.
issues.fix: Write fail-closed lifecycle/terminal receipts and only release a verified owned lock after group-dead and port-free proof.

issues.impact: c17, provenance and the message-boundary flag are recorded but actual worktree HEAD, immutable provenance content, parsed flag and feature state are not proven.
issues.fix: Verify worktree HEAD/provenance digest pre-start and persist product parsed-config/state receipts before requests.
